import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb

# Paths
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
TEST_PATH = f"{INPUT_DIR}/test.csv"
TRAIN_PATH = f"{INPUT_DIR}/train.csv"
SAMPLE_PATH = f"{INPUT_DIR}/sample_submission.csv"
SUBMISSION_PATH = f"{SUBMISSION_DIR}/submission.csv"

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_PATH)

# Target columns
TARGET_COLS = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]

# Split training data into train/val
# Use 80/20 split, stratify if possible but lightgbm handles class balance better
print("Splitting data...")
train_fold, val_fold = train_test_split(train_df, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)

# Vectorize text
print("Vectorizing text...")
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=50000, ngram_range=(1, 2), strip_accents="unicode"
)
X_train = vectorizer.fit_transform(train_fold["comment_text"].fillna(""))
X_val = vectorizer.transform(val_fold["comment_text"].fillna(""))
X_test = vectorizer.transform(test_df["comment_text"].fillna(""))

y_train = train_fold[TARGET_COLS].values
y_val = val_fold[TARGET_COLS].values

# Train models (one for each target)
print("Training models...")
models = {}
oof_preds = np.zeros((y_val.shape[0], len(TARGET_COLS)))

for i, target in enumerate(TARGET_COLS):
    model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
        n_estimators=200, max_depth=-1, learning_rate=0.05, verbose=-1, random_state=42
    )
    model.fit(X_train, y_train[:, i])
    models[target] = model
    oof_preds[:, i] = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]

# Evaluate on hold-out validation set
print("Evaluating on validation set...")
auc_scores = []
for i in range(len(TARGET_COLS)):
    col = TARGET_COLS[i]
    score = roc_auc_score(y_val[:, i], oof_preds[:, i])
    auc_scores.append(score)

mean_auc = np.mean(auc_scores)
print(f"Validation Column-wise ROC AUC: {mean_auc:.6f}")

# Generate submission
print("Generating submission...")
sub_preds = np.zeros((len(test_df), len(TARGET_COLS)))
for i, target in enumerate(TARGET_COLS):
    sub_preds[:, i] = models[target].predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Create submission dataframe
submission = sample_sub.copy()
submission.iloc[:, 1:] = sub_preds
submission.to_csv(SUBMISSION_PATH, index=False)

print(f"Submission saved to {SUBMISSION_PATH}")
print("Done.")
